map.解读新生儿/婴幼儿听力筛查结果，提供随访与诊断性评估建议: Interpret newborn/infant hearing-screening results; give follow-up and diagnostic-evaluation advice
map.提示：新生儿听力筛查遵循\"1-3-6\"原则：1月龄筛查、3月龄诊断、6月龄干: Note: newborn hearing screening follows the '1-3-6' principle: screen by 1 month, diagnose by 3 months, intervene by 6 months. High-risk factors: NICU >5 days, family deafness history, craniofacial anomaly, intrauterine infection (CMV/rubella), hyperbilirubinemia needing exchange transfusion, bacterial meningitis, mechanical ventilation. Both OAE and AABR fail -> workup for auditory neuropathy spectrum disorder (ANSD). This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.OAE 左右均 pass→通过，常规随访；有高危因素建议 AABR。: Both OAE ears pass -> pass, routine follow-up; with risk factors AABR is advised.
map.任一耳 refer→复查，仍 refer 转诊断性 ABR 与耳鼻喉。: Any ear refer -> re-screen; still refer -> refer for diagnostic ABR and ENT.
map.OAE 查耳蜗、AABR 查听神经脑干部；高危儿首选 AABR。: OAE checks cochlea, AABR checks auditory nerve-brainstem; AABR preferred for high-risk infants.
map.新生儿耳道胎脂可假 refer，42 天内复筛即可。: Newborn vernix can falsely refer; re-screen within 42 days is enough.
map.关于「听力(OAE/AABR)筛查结果器」: About the Hearing (OAE/AABR) Screening Result Tool
map.新生儿听力(OAE/AABR)筛查结果器，解读耳声发射与自动听性脑干反应筛查结果: The newborn hearing (OAE/AABR) screening result tool interprets otoacoustic-emission and automated auditory-brainstem-response results and follow-up advice. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
